|notes=The set was released 21 November 2003. The complete first sheet remains unlocated. The comparison dates each surviving issuer text. [https://web.archive.org/web/20031202154611id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm Players Committee release announcement]. The remaster excludes the indicated Reflections III Boba Fett in place of the destiny restriction. Its protection from exclusion or loss ends at the damage segment. Both retain the Slave I drawn-destiny bonus and the optional Effect loss for the weapon destiny bonus. 
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154341/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards6.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards6.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to card #32 on 14 September 2007); page 4, slip 48.
